entries.title: Job 5:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Eliphaz shews that the end of the wicked is misery; 6 that man is born to trouble; 8 that God is to be regarded in affliction; 17 the happy end of God's correction.

and to which. 15:8-10,15; Isa 41:1,21-23; Heb 12:1 the saints. 4:18; 15:15; De 33:2,3; Ps 16:3; 106:16; Eph 1:1 turn. or, look.

entries.title: Job 5:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: wrath. 18:4; Jon 4:9 the foolish. Ps 14:1; 75:4; 92:6; 107:17; Pr 1:22,23; 8:5; Ec 7:9 envy. or, indignation. Ge 30:1; 1Sa 18:8,9; Ro 2:8 one. Ho 7:11; 2Ti 3:6

entries.title: Job 5:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: harvest. De 28:33,51; Jud 6:3-6; Isa 62:8 the thorns. Jud 6:11; 2Ch 33:11 the robber. 1:15,17; 12:6; 18:9; Ho 8:7 swalloweth. 2:3; 20:15; Jer 51:34,44; La 2:5,16

entries.title: Job 5:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: affliction. or, iniquity. trouble. 34:29; De 32:27; 1Sa 6:9; Ps 90:7; Isa 45:7; La 3:38; Am 3:6 spring out. Ho 10:4; Heb 12:15

entries.title: Job 5:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: man. 14:1; Ge 3:17-19; Ps 90:8,9; 1Co 10:13 trouble. or, labour. Ec 1:8; 2:22; 5:15-17 sparks fly upward. Heb. sons of the burning coal lift up tofly.

entries.title: Job 5:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: doeth. 9:10; 11:7-9; 37:5; Ps 40:5; 72:18; 86:10; Ro 11:33 unsearchable. Heb. there is no search. Isa 40:28 marvellous. 26:5-14 without number. Heb. till there be no number. Ps 40:5; 139:18

entries.title: Job 5:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: disappointeth. 12:16,17; Ne 4:15; Ps 33:10,11; 37:17; Pr 21:30; Isa 8:10; 19:3 their hands. Ps 21:11; Isa 37:36; Ac 12:11; 23:12-22 their enterprise. or, anything.

entries.title: Job 5:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: meet with. or, run into. darkness. 12:25; De 28:29; Pr 4:19; Isa 59:10; Am 8:9

entries.title: Job 5:20
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: famine. Ge 45:7; 1Ki 17:6; Ps 33:19; Pr 10:3; Isa 33:16; Hab 3:17 redeem. Ps 49:7; Ho 13:14 in war. Ps 27:3; Mt 24:6 the power. Heb. hands.

entries.title: Job 5:21
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: be hid. Ps 31:20; 55:21; 57:4; Pr 12:18; Isa 54:17; Jer 18:18; Jas 3:5-8 from the scourge. or, when the tongue scourgeth. neither. Ps 91:5-7

entries.title: Job 5:22
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: laugh. 2Ki 19:21 afraid. Isa 35:9; 65:25; Eze 34:25

entries.title: Job 5:24
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: thou shalt know. 18:6,15,21; 21:7-9; 1Sa 30:3; Isa 4:5,6 thy tabernacle, etc. or, peace is thy tabernacle. Ps 25:13 thou shalt visit. De 28:6; Ps 91:10; 121:7,8 sin. or, err. Ps 107:4,40

entries.title: Job 5:25
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: thy seed. 42:13-16; Ge 15:5; Le 26:9; De 28:4; Ps 112:2; 127:3-5; 128:3-6 great. or, much. as the grass. Ps 72:16

entries.title: Job 5:26
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: in a full age. 42:16,17; Ge 15:15; 25:8; Ps 91:16; Pr 9:11; 10:27 cometh. Heb. ascendeth.

entries.title: Job 5:27
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: we have searched. 8:8-10; 12:2; 15:9,10,17; 32:11,12; Ps 111:2; Pr 2:3-5 for thy good. Heb. for thyself. 22:2; De 10:13; Pr 9:12
